method: Every Japanese clip a Disgaea D2 selector column lists for 25 characters that also exist in Disgaea 5 was matched by normalised waveform cross-correlation (>=0.6) to the D5 Japanese lines of the same character; D5's situation flags on the identical recording label the column. A (kind, situation) is routed when at least 15% of the column's matched clips carry it. Column 18 (whole-bank preview) is never routed. Independent check: the four columns DD2EVENT1 proved from the executable (6 lift, 7 throw, 10 level-up, 18 preview) come out the same here.

0:0.basis: DD2VOICE4 2026-11-14 (correction of the VOICE1 waveform route 0 / 1 / 10 / 11 / 13 + kind 1 situation 22 + kind 3 situations 0, 1): DD2LOGGER2 PROVED slot 0 = normal attack (32 picks, events 12000100/200/300/700/12012030 each followed by a damage record) and nothing else. Routed to D5 attack (kind 0, situation 0) only. D5 situation 1 is not added: vanilla D5 weapon-skill scripts call category 1 on the caster in 1 of 40 skills (Shotgun Craft) and category 0 in 12, so D5's skill scripts already ask for 0 themselves; the 'skill scripts also use slot 0' of DD2LOGGER2 is covered by 0. Lift (10), throw (11) and landing (13) come from slots 6, 7 and (held) 9, not from attack clips.

ship_rule: VOICE2b (coordinator, 2026-11-10): a battle column (category 0) ships only at >= 0.90 on the strict battle-only leave-one-character-out rate, or where both ends are proven from the executables (columns 6 lift, 7 throw: one proven situation each). Category 1 / 2 columns are never routed to battle kinds. Was: A column is used only when its leave-one-character-out hit rate is at least 0.8; the others stay silent (labelled, not guessed).

findings.battle_has_no_damage_or_death_voice: Disgaea D2 voices neither damage nor death in battle. The battle category (0) has columns 0-10 and the preview column 18 only: all 27 native callers of the selector wrapper 0x6b240 and all 803 literal script voice calls (opcode 0x4632, 12,483 framed events) ask for columns 0-10 or 18; the direct-id players (0x2e5cb0 callers) are scripts, a queued id and the fixed title id 9999001. A unique character's battle bank is used up by columns 0-10 (Laharl: 22 of 23 clips; none is a pain cry).
findings.category_1_is_not_battle: Columns 13-17 of category 1 are five mood buckets chosen outside battle: 0x275e64 picks one from a signed value at actor+0x6da (thresholds -39..39) of a menu actor list (stride 0xad0, cursor +0xf90); 0x1bb878 picks one for scripted hub events (event ids 3200000, 3003000, 2002000, 2004000 at actor+0x418) from a 0-5 result. Category 2 columns 11 / 12 are a yes / no pair (D5 keeps the same recordings as its kind 2 situations 29 / 30).
findings.why_d5_matched: D5 re-used some of these mood recordings as its own damage (20) and death (21) lines, which is why VOICE1's column match scored 0.56 / 0.73 on 1:13 / 1:14. Duration does not separate them (best bin 0.6-0.8 s: 6 of 11 matched clips are damage). No column or feature rule reaches the 0.90 bar, and the source game has no such situation to mirror, so damage and death stay silent for Disgaea D2 imports.
findings.d5_reuse_per_clip: For reference only (not built): D5 flags these DD2 recordings of the same character as damage 20 / death 21 -- Laharl 10010007, 10010008 / 20010002; Etna 10030010, 10030011 / -; Flonne 10050011, 10050012 / -; Pure Flonne 10060010, 10060011 / -; Petta 10270007, 10270008 / 10270009; Pleinair 10320011 / -; Nisa - / 10550017, 10550018. 7 of 26 packs would get a damage line and 4 a death line; using them would make the import speak where Disgaea D2 is silent (a D5 convention, Sean's call).
findings.voice2b_correction: VOICE2's first build still routed category 1 / 2 clips into battle situations as VOICE1 had (2:12 'no' line -> damage 20 among others; 1:17 -> joy 14 / 15; 2:11 -> heal). That contradicted 'Disgaea D2 voices no damage in battle' and is removed here.
findings.dd2voice4: DD2VOICE4 2026-11-14: damage taken, KO of a player or enemy unit, and defend produced no selector pick and no direct voice play in DD2LOGGER2 (Laharl, Etna, Flonne, Raspberyl, Adell, Yuri, Sicily took damage; Laharl, Etna, Flonne, Yuri were KO'd): not voiced in the source (DD2LOGGER2). This replaces the earlier reason 'pain columns matched 56-73%'. Evade, guard and level up through the end-of-battle screen were not reached or gave no pick.

hold_reasons.no_d5_situation: Disgaea D2 has the situation, Disgaea 5 does not (support attack): not routed, does not count.
hold_reasons.not_called_in_source: nothing in Disgaea D2 asks for the column in battle (category 0 slots 11-17): not routed, does not count.
hold_reasons.no_place_found: Disgaea D2 uses it (cinematic, menu or screen, level up) and no Disgaea 5 destination was found in the decomp functions / vanilla scripts opened: not routed, does not count.
hold_reasons.unproven: a Disgaea D2 situation seen but not proven (or a Disgaea 5 destination not proven): holds the character at partial.
hold_reasons.unknown: a column with no entry in this file: holds the character at partial.

dual_use_rule: A clip the source lists in two battle columns of different roles plays in both destinations (one source clip, two proven uses); the receipt's dual_use list names each such clip with its columns and destinations.
